title: Dispatch: clause obligation-boundary architecture (attempt 3)
description:
Human review of PR #475 at b0395e4 found FIVE P1 ARCHITECTURAL defects. Per the
churn stop rule this is a NEW DEFECT CLASS, so this is a re-architecture of the
obligation boundary, NOT five isolated patches. The supervisor has done the
threat model and fixed the architecture below; implement it.

=== FILES YOU OWN ===
  docs/adr/0020-source-clause-semantic-ir-and-completeness-contracts.md
  packages/core/src/rules/clauseIr/types.ts
  packages/core/src/rules/clauseIr/contracts.ts
  packages/core/src/rules/clauseIr/obligations.ts        (new)
  packages/core/src/rules/clauseIr/index.ts
  packages/core/test/clauseIrContracts.test.ts
  packages/core/test/clauseIrObligations.test.ts          (new)

=== SUPERVISOR THREAT MODEL — the evaluator must defeat all eight ===
T1 projector never declares an obligation the source contains -> nothing fails.
T2 projector misclassifies the clause to a narrower/laxer kind.
T3 projector declares the obligation but weakens its requirement list.
T4 caller passes a permissive or empty contract to the evaluator.
T5 caller asserts readiness dimensions true with no evidence.
T6 a kind contract demands semantically invalid things, pressuring projectors
   toward T2 to escape it.
T7 a family is reported covered although its obligations were never enumerated.
T8 unknown or contradictory contract selection silently defaults to something.

Every one of these needs an adversarial test named for the threat it defeats.

=== D1: OBLIGATIONS HAVE AN AUTHORITY INDEPENDENT OF THE PROJECTOR (T1,T2,T3) ===
Today `SourceObligation.requirements` is inline on the Clause, so the producer
of the output also defines the standard its output is judged by. That is the
root defect; the other four are consequences.

Introduce an OBLIGATION REGISTRY, separate from any clause:
  * a `SourceObligationRecord` carries obligationId (shared format above),
    `origin`, evidence, and `requiredFacets`.
  * `origin` is a closed union that CANNOT be 'projector':
    'source-extraction' | 'curated-specification' | 'audit-finding'.
  * a Clause REFERENCES obligations by id only. It must not be able to state
    their requirements.
  * the evaluator resolves each obligation FROM THE REGISTRY. A clause citing an
    obligationId absent from the registry FAILS CLOSED (defeats T2/T3).
  * registry construction validates that each record carries resolvable evidence
    of its declared origin.

=== D2: OMISSION MUST BE VISIBLE — CLOSURE OVER A SCOPE (T1, T7) ===
Add `evaluateObligationClosure(registry, clauses, scope)` returning, per
obligation: satisfied | claimed-incomplete | UNCLAIMED. An obligation in the
registry that no clause claims is the ONLY way T1 becomes visible, and it is the
real answer to finding 5: a record-family array establishes APPLICABILITY, never
closure. Keep these four concepts explicitly distinct in types and in the ADR:
family applicability; source-derived obligation membership; per-obligation
completeness; aggregate family closure.

=== D3: CANONICAL REQUIREMENTS ARE NOT BYPASSABLE (T4, T8) ===
`evaluateClauseCompleteness(clause, contract)` currently accepts ANY contract,
so an empty one certifies anything. Change the signature so the evaluator
derives the canonical contract internally from the resolved obligation's facets.
Extensions may only be ADDITIVE (`additionalRequirements`); there must be no
code path by which an ordinary caller removes a canonical requirement. Unknown
facet, unknown contract id, or contradictory selection FAILS CLOSED — never
defaults to a laxer contract.

=== D4: FACETS REPLACE UNIVERSAL KIND CONTRACTS (T6) ===
The `save` contract currently requires `nonEmpty('damage')`, so a save that
deals no damage — a save against being frightened — cannot be represented as
complete. That is an invalid universal assumption and it actively pressures
projectors toward T2.

Replace kind-level universals with COMPOSABLE SEMANTIC FACETS. Each facet owns
its own requirements; the OBLIGATION names which facets the source demands. The
model must express at least, and each needs a test:
  save with damage                     | save without damage
  save with alternate outcomes         | attack with one damage mode
  attack with conditional or mutually exclusive alternatives
  resource use with reset              | resource use without reset
  duration with concentration          | duration without concentration
  effect with lifecycle state          | effect without lifecycle state

DO NOT solve this by making requirements optional. The obligation must still
state EXACTLY which facets are required for that source clause; what changes is
that the requirement set comes from the source-declared facets rather than from
a blanket kind assumption.

=== D5: READINESS NEEDS EVIDENCE, NOT BOOLEANS (T5) ===
`ClauseReadiness.dimensions` is four caller-set booleans. Self-attestation is
not proof. Replace with per-dimension EVIDENCE:
  captured      resolvable source-span/authoritative-input evidence
  projected     DERIVED from the semantic evaluation — not settable by a caller
  supported     a capability reference naming an engine capability identity AND
                its owning bead; unresolved, unowned or unimplemented => failed
  discoverable  a resolver/index/path reference; unresolved => failed
Evidence must be inspectable and must reject stale or nonexistent references.
A clause must NOT be green when the representation exists but its required
engine capability is unowned.

This PR stays design/type-contract scope: do NOT build the engine capability
registry. Inject resolver interfaces (e.g. a CapabilityResolver and a
DiscoveryResolver) so the evaluator consumes evidence it cannot forge, and
provide test doubles. The requirement is that the TYPES AND EVALUATOR CANNOT
ENCODE SELF-ATTESTATION AS PROOF.

=== SHARED SOURCE-OBLIGATION IDENTITY (supervisor decision, binding across
PRs #475, #476, #477) ===
This identity is fixed by the supervisor so the three branches cannot invent
competing definitions. Implement it here; #476 and #477 will align to it.

  obligationId := "obl:<sourceRef>:<locator>:<facet>"
     sourceRef  stable source document identity, e.g. "srd-5.1"
     locator    source anchor, e.g. "p.104#fireball"
     facet      semantic facet name (see the facet model below)

EVIDENCE KIND is a closed union, shared conceptually across all three PRs. Never
overload one "sourceSpan" field to carry incompatible evidence types:

  'source-span'                 exact span in the licensed source document
  'authoritative-input'         non-PDF authoritative input (curated spec, table)
  'audit-finding'               a 2026-07-24 finding identity
  'code'                        an implementation site in @eshyra/core
  'bead'                        a bead identity
  'known-missing-source-clause' source clause known absent from projection

#475 owns 'source-span' and 'authoritative-input' in depth; the other members
must exist in the type so #476/#477 can align without redefining the union.

DO NOT import code across branches. Align the CONCEPTS; duplicate the small
identity/evidence types locally and note the integration boundary in the ADR.

=== ADR 0020 ===
Rewrite to describe this architecture: the obligation authority boundary, the
facet model, non-bypassable canonical requirements, evidence-backed readiness,
and the applicability/membership/completeness/closure distinction. State the
cross-PR identity and the deferred integration boundary. The ADR is what the
rest of the program cites — it must not describe the superseded design.

=== ENVIRONMENT AND VERIFICATION ===
Run `npm ci` FIRST. Run `npm run verify:worktree` BEFORE committing — it
rewrites files. Machine load matters: if rulesPackAuditCli or dolt-gated suites
time out, rerun that file in isolation before concluding a regression.

=== HARD CONSTRAINTS ===
* Edit ONLY the files under FILES YOU OWN. Do not touch package.json,
  packages/core/package.json, packages/core/src/internal.ts, AGENTS.md,
  CLAUDE.md, .github/, or any script/protocol/CI file. Adding review
  infrastructure is explicitly OUT OF SCOPE for this session.
* Do NOT regenerate the rules pack, run the SRD importer, or touch
  packages/core/data. Do not absorb importer migration or corpus recompilation —
  this PR stays design/type-contract scope.
* Do NOT modify any bead except your own. Do NOT run `bd dolt push`.
* Do NOT push, open/comment on a PR, or merge.
* PRESERVE the regression coverage for the three previously-fixed defect classes:
  requirement cardinality, independent readiness dimensions, and non-mutable
  disposition. If a preserved test must change shape, keep an equivalent
  assertion and say so in your notes.
* Where a committed test encodes defective behavior, change it deliberately and
  record why. Never delete a test to make a finding disappear.
acceptance_criteria:
• Obligations live in a registry with a non-projector origin; a clause can reference but never define them; an unknown obligationId fails closed.
• evaluateObligationClosure reports UNCLAIMED obligations, making omission visible; applicability, membership, completeness and closure are distinct in types and ADR.
• No caller-supplied contract can remove a canonical requirement; extensions are additive only; unknown/contradictory selection fails closed.
• Facets replace universal kind requirements; all twelve listed facet combinations are representable and tested, including save-without-damage.
• Readiness dimensions are evidence-backed; projected is derived; supported binds to a capability identity and owner and fails when unowned; resolvers are injected, not implemented here.
• An adversarial test exists for each of threats T1-T8, named for the threat.
• Prior regression coverage for cardinality, independent dimensions, and non-mutable disposition is preserved.
• ADR 0020 describes the new architecture and the shared cross-PR identity.
• npm run verify:worktree passes.
notes: Completion report: Re-architected the clause IR around an independently validated source-obligation registry. Clauses now reference obligation IDs only; registry records enforce non-projector origin, shared obl::: identity, closed evidence kinds, facet validation, contradiction rejection, and immutable records. Canonical requirements are derived from composable semantic facets with aggregate atom multiplicity and no caller-replaceable contract; closure now distinguishes applicability, source membership, per-obligation completeness, and UNCLAIMED scope coverage. Readiness now consumes captured evidence plus injected source/capability/discovery resolvers; projected is derived and supported/discoverable fail closed without owned, implemented, resolvable evidence. Rewrote ADR 0020 and added named T1-T8 adversarial tests while preserving cardinality, independent dimensions, and non-mutable disposition regression coverage. No design decision disagreed with; no in-scope obligation could not be satisfied. Deferred production source census/capability/discovery integration to follow-up eshyra-s38f. Verification: npm ci; npm run verify:worktree passed (264 test files passed, 4 skipped; 4726 passed, 19 skipped); isolated importer pipeline rerun passed 44/44 after one initial full-suite timeout under load. Commit 1b33b18.
